pages.text: Life Energy is an advanced derivative of Chi Energy. The Life Aggregation Converter consumes Chi Energy to aggregate Life Energy: $(br)Each operation consumes $(bold)10M Chi Energy$() and produces $(bold)10 Life Energy$().$(br)A standalone converter aggregates 10 times per second (10 Life/tick).

Surround a $(bold)Life Conversion Architecture$() core with $(bold)26 Life Aggregation Converters$() (3x3x3) to form the structure:$(br)$(li)Conversion speeds up to $(bold)45x$() (450 Life/tick, consuming 450M Chi/tick)$(li)Chi Energy enters through casings, Life Energy exits through casings$(li)Right-click any casing to open the architecture GUI

Life Energy Pipes transport Life Energy exclusively, isolated from Chi Energy pipes (energy type separation).$(br)Connect a converter to a Life pipe to export Life Energy; connect it to a Chi pipe to keep its Chi Energy buffer topped up.
